rows.en: (Aw man, my shoelace snapped...)

("Hard to walk" doesn't even begin
to cover it.)
Sigh, today's just not my day...

What's wrong,
\p?

Standing around in a place like this...
What on earth is the matter?

Actually, my shoelace snapped,
and I didn't know what to do.
Hm. Wait a moment.
Are you out shopping too, Sensei?
rows.notes: The name plate says Yamashiro, but the line is the player's question (the female version has the same line, c06262, under the player, and Yamashiro answers it in c06235). Translated as the player's line.

rows.en:
Here it is.
A spare shoelace. Use it.
...A spare?

That's right.
The color seems fine too.
...Thank you.

(Do people normally carry spare
shoelaces...?)

Hm?
No, some new books came in at the
library, so I went to see them.
Huh... That's just like you...
And you're out shopping alone, are you?

Couldn't you invite even one friend?
You're as lonely as ever.

Hm?
What's that sound?
It sounds like a cat meowing...
Over there, is it...
Poor thing, it's shivering...

Stuck in a place like this, and no collar...
Sensei, does this mean...

It's safe to conclude that
it's an abandoned cat.
Who would do something like this...

If you can't care for an animal to the end,
you have no business keeping one.
Much less a kitten like this...
(Yamashiro-sensei is angry...)

Hey, little one.
Where's your mother?
Is she gone?
Then, do you want to come with me?
There, there... You must've been cold.
Sensei, are you going to keep that kitten?

Yes. You couldn't just leave it there
either, could you?
That's true...
rows.notes: Shared: the player here and Akimizu agreeing about Sheryl in nml_yuu_018. Neutral.

rows.en:
I live a lonely life on my own anyway.
Gaining a family member suits me fine.
(Good thing it found a kind owner.)
(Oh no, my shoelace snapped...)
(Ugh, what a pain... Seriously...)
Phew, today's just not my day...

(Does anyone normally carry spare
shoelaces...?)
Are you out shopping too, Sensei?
Poor thing... It's shivering...
Sensei, are you going to keep the kitten?

(Good thing you found a kind owner,
kitty.)
(This is where that cat was abandoned...)
Oh, Yamashiro-sensei!
What are you doing in a place like this?

Oh, the cat from the other day crossed
my mind, so I just sort of came by.

Hm. That cat is lazing around
at my place again today.
Oh, I see. That's good to hear.

What about you, Sensei?
What brings you here?

Much the same, I suppose.
I came to see if its mother
might be around.

Even though I know she couldn't
possibly be here.
Oh, I see.
rows.notes: Shared with frd_itk_007 (both genders), after Yamashiro explains a real find is never easy to spot.

rows.en: And don't you stay out too late either.
Yes, I know.
See you later, then.
rows.notes: Shared: Yamashiro here and Kagura in nml_kgr_001. Neutral.

rows.en: (Sensei's looking for the mother cat, huh.)
(This is where that kitty was abandoned...)

Oh, the kitty from the other day crossed
my mind, so I just sort of came by...
Oh, I see. That's good to hear~
Oh, I see...
(So Sensei's looking for the mother cat.)

uncertain: c06229: name plate Yamashiro, but it is the player's question 'Are you out shopping too, Sensei?' (female twin c06262 is under the player; Yamashiro answers in c06235). Translated as the player's line; the plate may be a script bug.
c06250 'inai no ka?' given the subject 'she' (the mother cat Yamashiro just asked the kitten about).
c06235: toshokan (a public library, not the school's toshoshitsu) rendered 'the library'.
